in_sanskrit.name: धनलक्ष्मी
in_sanskrit.meaning: धनम् अपहनन् लक्ष्मी: धनं विनिमयितुं लक्ष्मी: धनवान् शक्तिः
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The goddess of wealth, the giver of prosperity, the destroyer of poverty, the one who bestows wealth, the one who possesses the power of wealth.

in_hindi.name: धनलक्ष्मी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The goddess of wealth, the companion of wealth.

in_tamil.name: தனனலக்ஷ்மி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The goddess of the wealth of our own people.

in_telugu.name: ధనలక్ஷ్మీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The goddess of wealth and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Dhanalakshmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wealth and Lakshmi (Goddess of prosperity)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanalakshmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanalakshmi is a combination of two words - Dhanam (wealth) and Lakshmi (Goddess of prosperity). In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. The name signifies the blessings of wealth and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Dhanalakshmi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wealth and Lakshmi (Goddess of prosperity)
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhanalakshmi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dhanalakshmi is a combination of two words - Dhanam (wealth) and Lakshmi (Goddess of prosperity). In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. The name signifies the blessings of wealth and prosperity.
